title: An International Consortium for Evaluations of Societal-Scale Risks from Advanced AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks and does not mention any measurements related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research. The paper proposes a framework for an international consortium to evaluate societal-scale risks from AI in general.
